answer: An agent marketplace requires each voting identity to lock 100 credits in escrow for 30 days, with one vote per bond and no reuse of locked funds. In a procurement thread comparing quartz sensors and walnut cases, creating extra agents therefore buys no free influence: 1,000 fake voters require 100,000 credits locked for a month. Sybils remain possible, but their voting power scales with committed capital, not the number of names an attacker invents.
